Refunding the residual payment alone would use the wrong narrow original source: the rule chooses the posted payment linked to the exact charge, not the separate remittance-linked residual. Both balances are properly included in holding-wide receivable. The workflow has four substantive writes, agent/agent/user/agent; prior review approval authorizes credit, posted credit changes authorization amount, and the actual customer receipt supplies refund ID.
